title: Innokin Kwik 35K Strawberry Mix Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Strawberry Mix captures the taste of ripe, sun-sweetened Strawberries for a bright, juicy vape that remains consistent from start to finish. The blend offers sweetness that tastes clean and balanced, making it ideal for all-day use. Each pack contains a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml refill container built for the Innokin Kwik 10+2 device. The mesh-coil design enhances flavour clarity, while the dual-chamber auto-feed system keeps the coil saturated for steady performance. How to Set Up Innokin Kwik 35K Prefilled Pod Step 1 Insert the prefilled pod into the Kwik 10+2 device until it clicks. Step 2 Fit the 10ml refill container securely into the base compartment. Step 3 Inhale on the mouthpiece to vape. Replace the pod pack once both chambers are empty. ✅ You're all set!
